topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I found out today that my friend hasn’t actually been at that prestigious job everyone thought. I’m not sure how to face them now, or what to say. It feels like everything I knew about them is a bit shaky. I keep thinking about all the times I congratulated them, bragged to others about their success. How do I trust what they’ve told me about anything else? I know confrontation might not go well, but I can’t just let it slide, can I? I wish there was a right answer, a way to fix things without making them worse. I’m not sure if I’m ready to have this conversation, but maybe avoiding it won’t make it go away.
